title: Context of the organisation: the boundary of the management system and what it must satisfy
Leadership: policy, accountability, and assigned roles at the top of the organisation
Planning: risk assessment and treatment, the Statement of Applicability, and objectives
notes: The Statement of Applicability is the closest published artefact to what this tool produces: a per-control decision to include or exclude, with the reasoning attached.

title: Support: resources, competence, awareness, communication, and documented information
Operation: carrying out the planned processes and keeping evidence that they ran
Performance evaluation: measurement, internal audit, and management review
Improvement: handling nonconformity and taking corrective action
Organizational controls: policy, roles, supplier relationships, incident management, continuity
People controls: screening, terms of employment, awareness, disciplinary process, and departure
Physical controls: perimeters, entry, equipment siting, and secure disposal
Technological controls: access, cryptography, logging, configuration, development, and resilience
notes: Where a derivation from a security baseline lands almost entirely. Thirty-four controls in the 2022 revision, so a single line here stands for a great deal.
